'''2008 Worlds Team Brian Fried DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fried]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Frankenfish. Header inventory Brian Fred; sheet Brian Fried.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Fried]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
